result.summary: The home feed is mostly intact, but one layout defect stands out: in the 'Fastest near you' carousel the second card (Smash Bros Burgers) is shifted down relative to the cards on either side, breaking the row's top alignment.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card sits about 28px lower than the 'Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccola' cards. Its image, time badge, title and delivery fee are all offset downward, so the row looks uneven and the card's text crowds the 'Popular right now' section below.
issues.suggestion: Align all carousel cards to the top of the row (e.g. align-items: flex-start on the container) and remove any stray top margin, padding or transform on the second card so images and text baselines line up across the row.
